label: The global mirror image of the actual world has the opposite handedness
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the feature H (global spatial handedness) holds at the mirror image σ w exactly when it fails at w. The mirror image is a different arrangement. Spatial reflection and CPT conjugation both reverse spatial handedness. A relationalist about orientation who identifies a world with its global mirror image (σ w = w) denies it; so does anyone for whom global handedness is no feature of a world.
